name: Volunteer Internships at the National Museum of Nuclear Science and History
org: National Museum of Nuclear Science and History
what_you_do: Interns pick a project that fits academic goals and museum goals. They also help with education programs and special events. A general track rotates you through the museum.
pay_detail: Not stated on the program page.
duration: At least 12 weeks, full time or part time
deadline_text: No dates are listed on the program page.
how_to_apply: Email the museum's Volunteer Coordinator. The email is on the program page. No separate form is described.
notes: Hours depend on your schedule and the museum's needs. Events named on the page include STEM Day and Nuclear Science Week. The program page does not say whether applications are open. Ask about pay when you write.
